test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 26 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which word is nearest in meaning to endeavoured? "Framton Nuttel endeavoured to say the correct something which should duly flatter the niece."
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Attempted**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Endeavoured"** means to try hard to do or achieve something. (प्रयास करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The athlete endeavoured to break the world record despite the challenges.
 
 
• **"Attempted"** is the word closest in meaning to "endeavoured," as it also refers to making an effort to achieve something. (कोशिश करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She attempted to climb the mountain, but the weather conditions forced her to stop halfway.
 
 
• Hence, the correct word is **Attempted** (कोशिश करना).

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Attempted**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Avoided** (बचना): To keep away from or stop oneself from doing something.
 
 
• **Example:** He avoided answering the difficult question by changing the topic.
 
 
 
• **Refused** (इंकार किया): To indicate or show that one is not willing to do something.
 
 
• **Example:** She refused to participate in the event due to personal reasons.
 
 
 
• **Ignored** (अनदेखा करना): To deliberately pay no attention to someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** He ignored the warning signs and continued driving recklessly.
 
 

4a:T90b,

The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Potable**.
